unit.why: A short hagiographic account of R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev's prayer: his trembling, his bowing that carried him from corner to corner, and the terror of those who watched. It describes recurring events rather than a single episode, which makes it a borderline story.
unit.boundary_note: Section (ג) of a series of praises of the Berditchever; the next division (ד) begins a separate anecdote.

stories.start_quote: הגאון הקדוש הרב מבארדיטשוב יודעי חן
stories.end_quote: ואימת מות נפלו עליהם ויעמדו מרחוק
stories.summary_en: R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev, said to carry the soul of R. Akiva, would tremble and bow so violently in prayer that he moved from corner to corner, and all who stood by him were seized with mortal dread.
